Public relations specifically deals with managing communication between an organization and its publics, including handling negative publicity and building/maintaining a positive corporate image. Personal selling involves direct person-to-person communication to make sales, sales promotion uses short-term incentives to stimulate demand, and direct marketing communicates directly with consumers to generate responses - none of these primarily focus on managing unfavorable stories or corporate image in the way public relations does.

Final answer: (D)
